Longest Solar Eclipse of the Century to Occur

The longest solar eclipse of the 21st century is set to occur, lasting for six minutes and 23 seconds. This rare celestial event will cause darkness during the day in several countries. Scientists are noting its unusual duration and scientific significance. The eclipse is also being linked to astrological interpretations regarding its impact on zodiac signs and upcoming festivals.
